rubrics.justification: Generally plausible blastocyst description with appropriate caveats about single-image limits, but it introduces uncertainty and some speculative details (collapsed appearance, uneven TE, unclear ICM) despite the provided 3AA lab grade and includes grading-stage confusion.
Integrates age, AMH/FSH, prior failed cycles, sperm parameters, diagnosis, endometrium, and lifestyle reasonably well with embryo quality, though some interactions are discussed somewhat generically.
Overall structured and mostly logical, but there are minor inconsistencies such as questioning hatching/stage terminology and mixed statements about endometrial thickness and prognosis.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice (single embryo transfer, luteal support, cavity review after repeated failure, cautious use of PGT-A/add-ons), though a few comments are imprecise or not strongly guideline-based.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future evaluation, including SET, luteal support, uterine cavity assessment, endocrine review, and sperm DNA fragmentation consideration; useful though not highly tailored beyond standard workup.
